remarks: *FRESHLY PAINTED AND READY FOR MOVE IN* Discover one of the largest units in the sought-after Oenoke Association! This bright and airy 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom (both remodeled) first-floor condo spans 1,376 sq. ft. and features beautiful hardwood floors throughout. The remodeled kitchen boasts granite countertops and tile flooring, while the dining room and sun-filled living room provides comfort and charm.  Enjoy the convenience of a private garage (#92) plus a reserved parking spot, along with access to a laundry and storage room in the basement. The well-managed complex offers two pools, and common charges include heat, hot water, and A/C for added ease.  Perfectly located within walking distance to town, train, shops, and restaurants, this condo is a fantastic opportunity for those seeking both space and convenience in a vibrant community.
